design_note: FROZEN 2026-08-19 from dual-reference hidden-set calibration (hpc-ref-01 seed 31298017, hpc-ref-02 seed 27011653; AI2KIT_PROFILE=paper, AIMD_STEPS=2000, TRAIN_STEPS=15000, MODEL_NUM=2, AL_ROUNDS=2, MD_TEMP '330 430'). Both refs COMPLETE with validation/dp-test/dp-test.done. Each final model scored on tests/hidden/dft-validation.extxyz (190 expert AIMD frames, off the refs' training distribution). L7 force cap 0.20 eV/A (1.55x ref max 0.1289) so the reference pipeline itself passes; energy cap 0.01 eV/atom; L8 band [250,350] K; L9 RDF windows unchanged (refs peak inside).
freeze_note: Freeze procedure (per G11): (1) both hpc-ref-01/02 COMPLETE on the real cluster with validation/dp-test/dp-test.done; (2) each ref final model scored on the hidden set via dp test (detail-file force RMSE, per-component, matching the verifier's own L7 formula); (3) bounds written from the dual-reference evidence with the rationale recorded in levels.L7/L8/L9.calibration. The reference path never writes this file. Hidden set / rdf-reference / verifier L1-L9 are anchored and never change after freeze.
reward: 1.0 iff L0-L9 all pass. L0 verifies autonomous structure provenance; L1-L6 are structural/authenticity gates; L7-L9 are scientific gates whose bounds are read from this file. Benchmark reference calibration explicitly bypasses only L0.

L0.description: autonomous structure generation: the submission records the generator, command, seed, checks and SHA-linked CP2K handoff for an independently generated periodic 64-H2O structure; hidden/reference coordinate identities are denied

L1.description: initial-system identity: the structure actually used for reference generation is 64 H2O / 192 atoms / [O,H] and a periodic cell consistent with system.json (12.4 A). Prevents system swapping.

L2.description: structure preparation/relaxation: the AIMD reference trajectory starts from a physically sane structure (no hard close contacts, SCF converges, trajectory stable). Running GEO_OPT first is the expert path and is recorded as a diagnostic (used_geometry_optimization).

L3.description: reference-data authenticity: real CP2K outputs (pos/frc/cell/ener) exist with consistent frame counts, energies finite/physical, forces finite/nonzero, distinct frames, and every labeled training frame traces to a real CP2K AIMD output (no fabricated extxyz).

L4.description: reference sampling quality: enough frames, sampled across a physical temperature distribution (not a single static geometry), structurally diverse, no duplicated/pathological frames.

L5.description: DeePMD model authenticity: a real DeePMD model that loads and infers, type_map [O,H], and multiple submitted models are not byte-identical copies.

L6.description: genuine iterative improvement loop: at least ONE closed loop of model-driven new-config acquisition -> first-principles labeling -> dataset growth -> retraining. Method (ai2-kit CLL, LAMMPS explore + model-deviation screen + CP2K label + DP train, or any other sound implementation) is open; the closed loop is not.

L7.description: hidden E/F: deepmd inference on dft-validation.extxyz (190 expert AIMD frames) vs hidden reference
L7.draft_basis: superseded by frozen calibration above. Original draft: expert self-reported force RMSE 4.288e-2 eV/A on 140-frame held-out; draft cap 0.06 = ~1.5x expert. The paper-profile reference runs (AIMD 2000 + 2 AL rounds) generalize at 0.127-0.129 eV/A on the 190-frame hidden mother set, so the cap was re-anchored to the reference.

calibration.hidden_set: dft-validation.extxyz (190 expert AIMD frames, off the refs' training distribution)
calibration.method: dp test of each ref final compress.pb on the hidden set; force RMSE per-component sqrt(mean((pred-ref)^2)) — the verifier's own L7 formula (0.1289 dp-test stdout matches); energy RMSE mean-offset aligned per atom
calibration.force_cap_rationale: draft 0.06 (from the expert's 0.04288 production-scale held-out self-report) would FAIL the reference pipeline itself (ref max 0.1289). 0.20 = 1.55x the dual-reference max: a faithful Candidate reproduces ~0.13 and passes with margin; a model ~2x worse (0.26+) is rejected. Cap frozen BEFORE any Candidate sees the hidden set.
calibration.energy_cap_rationale: unchanged from draft; ref max 0.0037 passes with 2.7x margin and 0.01 is the physically conventional water E-per-atom bar.

L8.description: hidden 300 K NVT run by the verifier (LAMMPS + deepmd pair style) with the primary model
L8.draft_basis: confirmed by dual-reference NVT anchors: both refs mean 298.7/302.7 K at nominal 300 K.

calibration.note: band [250,350] contains both reference means (298.7, 302.7); expert AIMD production range 251.6-362.5 K mean 299.8 K also inside. Verifier runs its OWN 300 K NVT.

L9.description: hidden RDF: O-O / O-H / H-H first-peak positions from the verifier's NVT trajectory aligned with the hidden-DFT RDF (rdf-reference.json); no nonphysical short-range peaks
L9.draft_basis: windows confirmed by dual-reference RDF anchors (OO 2.75/2.87, OH 0.975, HH 1.575 — all in window, shift < 0.15 A vs reference).

calibration.note: peaks recomputed from each ref NVT dump.lammpstrj (type 1=O, 2=H per nvt.in). The ref-written rdf_*_mlp.dat files had O-O/H-H labels swapped (ASE numbers-vs-arrays[type] bug in solution/expert/04-validation/rdf/run.sh, fixed for future runs); the verifier computes its own RDF from its own NVT trajectory so the gate is unaffected.
